question: List all genre names in alphabetical order.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre ORDER BY Name

question: How many tracks are longer than 5 minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 300000
notes: Unit trap: Track.Milliseconds is in ms.

question: What is the total revenue across all invoices?
Which country has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT Country FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
notes: USA (13) is a unique maximum. Extra count column is acceptable (column-superset matching).

question: List the titles of all albums by AC/DC.
gold_sql: SELECT a.Title FROM Album a JOIN Artist r ON a.ArtistId = r.ArtistId WHERE r.Name = 'AC/DC'

question: What is the total sales amount per billing country? Return country and total, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY SUM(Total) DESC
notes: Ordering is part of the question; ties beyond top 5 could reorder, so ordered comparison is on the full list.

question: Which artist has the most tracks? Return the artist name and track count.
gold_sql: SELECT r.Name, COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Album a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId JOIN Artist r ON a.ArtistId = r.ArtistId GROUP BY r.ArtistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
notes: Iron Maiden (213) is a unique maximum. Requires the Track->Album->Artist chain.

question: List the names of tracks on the 'Grunge' playlist.
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId WHERE p.Name = 'Grunge'
notes: Needs the PlaylistTrack junction table; a no-schema prompt tends to guess wrong.

question: Which employees have no direct reports? Return first and last name.
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE EmployeeId NOT IN (SELECT ReportsTo FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL)
notes: Self-referencing Employee.ReportsTo; NOT IN needs the IS NOT NULL guard.

question: How many tracks are longer than the average track length?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > (SELECT AVG(Milliseconds) FROM Track)

question: Who is our best customer?
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1
notes: Ambiguous. Reference = highest total spend. Graded by the model judge, which accepts other reasonable readings (e.g. spend + invoice count).
